scenarios.name: 历史按季产量基准
scenarios.rule: For each observed crop-season, use its 2023 production estimate as the annual normal-sales limit. For an eligible but unobserved crop-season, use zero only inside this modeling scenario.

scenarios.name: 未观测季次分配5%
scenarios.rule: For a crop with one observed eligible season and one unobserved eligible season, preserve the crop's D0 annual total and allocate 95% to the observed season and 5% to the unobserved season. Other crop-season limits remain as D0.

scenarios.name: 未观测季次分配10%
scenarios.rule: For a crop with one observed eligible season and one unobserved eligible season, preserve the crop's D0 annual total and allocate 90% to the observed season and 10% to the unobserved season. Other crop-season limits remain as D0.

boundaries: These are explicit Q1 modeling assumptions, not observed demand.
The frozen coverage.csv remains unchanged and all normal_sales_limit_jin fields stay blank.
A sales pool is shared by all village plots and land types within the same crop-year-season.
Sales cannot be carried from one season to another.
No Q2 stochastic changes are introduced.
